description: Fetch the SSVC decision points CISA publishes per CVE as a CVE Authorized Data Publisher — Exploitation, Automatable, and Technical Impact — along with the CVSS score and CWE CISA contributes where present, and compute the BOD 26-04 remediation timeline those values imply for the asset exposure you supply. The computed timeline applies CISA's published decision table to CISA's published decision points and your stated exposure; it is not a compliance determination and it is not CISA's own due-date assignment, which is reported separately when the CVE is in KEV and can differ. Not every CVE is enriched — a miss returns found false with guidance rather than an error. Call cisa_list_reference with topic ssvc_values for the decision-point vocabulary.

assetExposure.description: Whether the affected asset is reachable by unauthenticated or untrusted entities over public networks. The one BOD 26-04 decision point CISA cannot publish. "unknown" returns both arms so the spread is visible without guessing.

cveIds.description: CVE identifiers to look up, up to 50 per call — lower than cisa_check_cve_status's 200-CVE cap because each CVE needs its own live enrichment lookup rather than a cached batch check.

items.description: One CVE identifier, e.g. CVE-2025-39964. Case and surrounding whitespace are normalized.

name: cisa_get_ssvc

echo.description: The request as the server parsed it.

assetExposure.description: The asset exposure the server applied.

requested.description: How many CVE IDs were requested.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `enrichment_source_unavailable`: Every per-CVE fetch failed with a transport or 5xx error. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

foundCount.description: How many CVEs carry published SSVC decision points.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing was enriched, or when a decision timestamp predates KEV.

results.description: One result per requested CVE, in the order supplied.

assignmentAgrees.description: Whether CISA's assigned deadline matches the computed timeline. Present only when the CVE is in KEV and an exposure was stated. Reported, never reconciled.

automatable.description: The SSVC Automatable value (yes or no).

bod2604.description: The BOD 26-04 timeline implied by the published decision points.

basis.description: The decision table the timeline was resolved against.

caveat.description: What the computation is and is not. Fixed text on every result.

timelines.description: One timeline per exposure arm — one when the caller stated an exposure, both when it is unknown.

assetExposure.description: The exposure arm this timeline applies to.

forensicTriageRequired.description: Whether a forensic triage of the asset is also required.

remediationTimelineDays.description: Calendar days allowed, or null for "Fix on system upgrade".

timelineLabel.description: The agency timeline in the directive's own wording.

cveId.description: The CVE identifier that was looked up.

cvss.description: The CVSS score CISA contributed through its ADP container, when present.

version.description: CVSS version of the contributed score.

cwes.description: CWEs CISA contributed. Empty when none were published.

items.description: One CWE from the CISA-authored container.

exploitation.description: The SSVC Exploitation value (none, poc, or active). Values outside that set are passed through verbatim.

found.description: Whether CISA has published SSVC decision points for this CVE.

guidance.description: What to do instead, present on every result where found is false.

inKev.description: Whether the CVE is in this server's KEV catalog snapshot.

kevAssigned.description: CISA's own assignment for this CVE, reported alongside the computation.

dateAdded.description: Date CISA added the CVE to the KEV catalog.

daysFromAdd.description: Calendar days from dateAdded to dueDate.

directive.description: The directive the KEV entry cites, or null when it cites neither.

forensicTriage.description: Whether the KEV entry is in the three-day forensic-triage tier.

sourceUrl.description: The Vulnrichment record URL this result was read from.

ssvcRole.description: The SSVC role CISA recorded, e.g. CISA Coordinator.

ssvcTimestamp.description: When CISA published these decision points, ISO 8601.

ssvcVersion.description: SSVC schema version CISA published against.

technicalImpact.description: The SSVC Technical Impact value (partial or total).

title: cisa_get_ssvc
